Static genuineness checks (constants, missing assertions, skips, mocks, patches, imports of implementation modules) do not prove a test measures the right thing; mutation testing of implementation files is not implemented.

integration_notes: After merging this branch the ledger docs/v5/ACCEPTANCE_LEDGER.jsonl is the change-control anchor: only the integration branch may append to it (run build-manifest / merge-workstreams after each merge and commit manifest + ledger).
